name: gama-kss-flight-card
description: GAMA KSS daily flight card + fuel uplift web app (single-file, offline, GitHub Pages)

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.jsx --loader:.jsx=jsx --jsx=automatic --bundle --minify --outfile=build/app.js && esbuild src/fuelcalc.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=build/fuelcalc.cjs --log-level=warning && python3 build_html.py
scripts.test: for t in domtest3 domtest4 domtest6 domtest7 domtest8 domtest10 domtest11 domtest12 domtest13 domtest14 domtest15 domtest16 domtest17 domtest19 domtest20 domtest21 domtest22 domtest23; do echo "== $t"; node $t.js || exit 1; done
